name: Petroli d'Oro
description: The golden standard in performance fuels.
story: Petroli d'Oro is a family-owned Italian oil and fuel producer with a history dating back to the golden age of Italian motorsports. We believe in supporting up-and-coming talent and are looking for a team that embodies the passion and dedication that drives our own success. We seek a partnership that can help us expand our brand recognition within the racing community.
